answer: Each identity binds to one hardware attestation quote at registration and must present a fresh quote every 16 epochs; a chip that signs for two identities burns both seats. Forging 681 identities costs 681 real chips plus the registration bond, while one honest agent needs a single device it already owns. The fable test is the live device, the zenith test is the locked stake, and the juniper test is the graded history no template can fake.
